title: bugs in docs (2.8.0 stable)
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

in this [page](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/torch_cuda_memory.html)  (2.8.0 stable)
Two links point to memory visualization, which should be `https://pytorch.org/memory_viz` but for some reason, the second link, in #Using the visualizer section:
>Open [pytorch.org/memory_viz](https://pytorch.org/memory_viz%3E) and drag/drop the pickled snapshot file into the visualizer. The visualizer is a javascript application that runs locally on your computer. It does not upload any snapshot data.

is parsed to `https://docs.pytorch.org/memory_viz%3E` and brings us to a weird place
